shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs saw $144M in outflows, causing BTC price to drop to $63,700.
US July CPI inflation data due Aug 12 is seen as a crucial macro trigger for the crypto market.
Geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran persist, negatively impacting crypto market gains.
Institutions are accumulating spot Ethereum at 7.2x the usual rate ahead of CPI data.
Bitcoin struggles below $65K resistance for a fourth day and dipped below $64,000.
